name: Guillaume Lample
bio: Guillaume Lample is a French AI researcher and co-founder and Chief Science Officer of Mistral AI. Before Mistral, Lample was a research scientist at Facebook AI Research (Meta) in Paris, working on natural language processing and machine translation. Lample is a co-author of the original LLaMA and Mistral 7B papers.
known_for: Co-author of the LLaMA paper at Meta
Research on neural named entity recognition and machine translation
